spring.name: spring
spring.description: A helical compression spring: a wire-radius circle swept along a helix. Parameters R (coil radius), W (wire radius), P (pitch), N (turns). Designed for a blank model (File ▸ New Blank Model) — its sweep references the face/edge ids the first two steps create on an empty base.

bolt-circle-flange.name: bolt-circle-flange
bolt-circle-flange.description: A round flange with a ring of N bolt holes at radius R (the doc/tutorials/bolt-circle-flange.md walkthrough as a runnable macro). Patterns the cutting tool then subtracts the whole ring at once. Designed for a blank model — its pattern/boolean reference the solids the first two steps create on an empty base. Note: overriding N past 8 also needs the subtract's id list widened by hand (entity references stay literal).

hex-bolt.name: hex-bolt
hex-bolt.description: A hex-head bolt blank: 6-sided prism head fused to a shaft cylinder. Parameters headR (head circumradius), headH, shaftR, shaftL. Designed for a blank model — its boolean references the two solids the first steps create on an empty base.
